```{python}


def parse_metacyc_compounds(filepath):
    inchikey_map = {}
    current = {}
    with open(filepath, "r", encoding="latin-1") as f:
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if line.startswith("UNIQUE-ID"):
                current["id"] = line.split(" - ", 1)[1]
            elif line.startswith("INCHI-KEY"):
                current["inchikey"] = (
                    line.split(" - ", 1)[1].replace("InChIKey=", "").strip()
                )
            elif line == "//":
                if "id" in current and "inchikey" in current:
                    inchikey_map[current["inchikey"]] = current["id"]
                current = {}
    return inchikey_map


def map_by_inchikey(excel_path, compounds_dat_path, inchikey_col="inchikey"):
    df = pd.read_excel(excel_path)
    inchikey_map = parse_metacyc_compounds(compounds_dat_path)

    df["metacyc_id"] = df[inchikey_col].map(inchikey_map)
    df["matched"] = df["metacyc_id"].notna()

    print(f"Matched:   {df['matched'].sum()} / {len(df)}")
    print(f"Unmatched: {(~df['matched']).sum()}")
    return df


df_mapped = map_by_inchikey(
    excel_path="your_data.xlsx",
    compounds_dat_path="compounds.dat",
    inchikey_col="inchikey",  # <-- change to your actual column name
)

df_mapped.to_excel("compound_mapping_results.xlsx", index=False)
```

```{python}
# Add fallback: match on first layer only (connectivity block)
metacyc_first_layer = {k[:14]: v for k, v in inchikey_map.items()}

def match_with_fallback(inchikey):
    if pd.isna(inchikey):
        return None, None
    full_match = inchikey_map.get(inchikey)
    if full_match:
        return full_match, 'full_inchikey'
    first_layer_match = metacyc_first_layer.get(inchikey[:14])
    if first_layer_match:
        return first_layer_match, 'first_layer_fallback'
    return None, 'no_match'

df_mapped[['metacyc_id', 'match_method']] = df_mapped['inchikey'].apply(
    lambda x: pd.Series(match_with_fallback(x))
)
```
